description.en: An OpenAI-compatible chat completions URL. Its host must be one this app is approved to reach.
description.zh_CN: OpenAI 兼容的 chat completions 地址。它的主机必须在本应用已获批的域名列表里。

description.en: The model name, as your provider spells it.
description.zh_CN: 模型名称，按你的服务商的写法填。

description.en: Sent as a bearer token, to that endpoint and nowhere else.
description.zh_CN: 作为 bearer token 发给上面那个地址，不会发给别处。

label.en: What to do with a verdict

description.en: Flag for a moderator to settle. There is no delete: a model's mistake should cost ten seconds in the queue, not somebody their post.
description.zh_CN: 打旗标交给版主判断。没有「删除」这个选项：模型判错的代价应该是版主花十秒，而不是某人丢一个帖子。

label.zh_CN: 也判断首次发帖的账号

description.en: Off, only reported accounts are looked at. On catches more, and costs more.
description.zh_CN: 关闭时只看被举报的账号。打开能抓到更多，也更费钱。

label.en: Never judge members at or above this trust level
label.zh_CN: 不判断信任等级不低于此值的成员

description.en: A model handed one sentence still answers, confidently.
description.zh_CN: 只给模型一句话，它照样会很自信地给出答案。

label.zh_CN: 接受其他节点得出的判定

description.en: Saves the cost of asking twice, at the price of somebody else's model deciding about your members.
description.zh_CN: 省下重复提问的钱，代价是别人的模型在替你的成员做判断。

label.en: How long a verdict lasts, in days
